title: Young Couple Portrait, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp 1950 black and white full-length snapshot of a young couple standing arm-in-arm outdoors. The woman is dressed in a patterned plaid A-line dress with a waist belt and carries a purse, while the man wears a classic 1950s open-collar shirt, trousers, and holds a cigarette in his hand. A brick building and trees fill the sunny background. The reverse side features a handwritten date reading June 24, 1950.
